purpose: Compare completed inference admission decisions before and after issue 615 PR A; not estimator accuracy or paper training replay.

coverage.actual_cpu: 288 cases: repeated or distinct Linear modules, 4/32 features, sequence length 7/101, 1/8 calls; three anchor batches; cap equality and +/- one byte; max batch unrestricted or 3.
coverage.frozen_large: 1584 cases: linear/quadratic virtual activation footprints, parameters 0/1024/16 GiB, eleven temporal declarations including absent and both sides of 800000 intensity boundaries; batch lists [8,3,1]/[7,3], maximum batch unrestricted/3; caps at equality and +/- one byte.

limitations: Real model probes use CPU only. Large cases supply frozen structural observations and never allocate those virtual shapes.
Comparison is selected batch or completed static refusal plus decision inputs, not diagnostic message equality.
No claims about real GPU peaks, estimator false-positive rate, timeout or allocation-failure behavior, stochastic LLM outputs, or training artifacts.
Shared-module parameter overcount and conservative activation summation intentionally remain unchanged for later estimator work.
